description: Default capability for compact widget + main dashboard webviews. Grants core IPC permissions used by tauri-plugin-updater + TauRPC handlers (cross-cutting envelope: health, app_info, ready, get_settings, update_settings per arch §Standard Contracts). Per-procedure granularity is not enforced at capability level — TauRPC dispatches all router methods through a single invoke handler; xtask capability-drift gate (route#22) introspects the router and asserts router-level coverage. Per chunk #47 also covers plugins.{list,reload,invoke} (router-level coverage per CLAUDE.md Session Additions 2026-05-03 TauRPC capability rule). Per chunk #49 also covers mcp.{status,start,stop} (sidecar lifecycle gated by --features mcp-server build + ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED runtime env var; double-gate re-validated at IPC entry per security plan §Anti-Patterns Code Patterns row 3). Per chunk #68 also covers storage.{inspect,path} (persistent incident corpus introspection — read-only-by-design per capability P-051; deletion is a separate procedure with explicit confirmation deferred to follow-up chunk). Per chunk #69 Phase B also covers diagnostics.template_distribution (Drain log-template-mining profiling — read-only-by-design; in-memory template tree query for the Settings → Diagnostics panel). Per chunk #78 also covers incidents.{list_active,acknowledge,mark_resolved} (corpus-backed Active/Resolved lifecycle persistence + acknowledge cool-down 5-min per kind-and-scope + workspace attribution + P-045 counter derivation; auto-resolution at 120s no-reemission per capability P-022; broadcast topic pulse://stream/incidents emits bounded lifecycle events Created/Updated/Resolved/Acknowledged). Per chunk #82 also covers model.current_profile (L4 LLM interpretation pipeline — hardware profile + model tier + load status + semantic model identity; backed by interpretation::contract::LlmInferenceRunner trait and concrete MistralRsInference stub returning ModelStatus::Error until ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MODEL_PATH is configured per capabilities P-053/P-054). Per chunk #86 also covers diagnostics.retry_interpretation (manual L4 interpretation retry override during exponential backoff cool-down per capability P-020 graceful degradation reaching full; backoff progression 2→5→10 min capped resets immediately on successful parse OR manual retry; resolution summaries attach к incident BLOB without surface notification per capabilities P-022 + P-059). Per chunk #87 also covers incidents.mark_all_read (Findings counter + dropdown bulk-mark-as-read action — workspace-scoped, sets read_at_unix_nano on all unread Active / Acknowledged incidents in the current workspace, persist failures non-fatal, single aggregate incident.broadcast.bulk_acknowledged tracing event per invocation preserving cardinality discipline per CLAUDE.md observability 2026-05-17 session 84; capabilities P-028 Findings Counter + P-029 Findings Dropdown + P-030 No Interrupting Notifications). Per chunk #88 also covers incidents.get_report (Diagnostic Report generation — in-app six-section L5 surface rendering L4 LLM interpretation output: symptom / timeline / hypotheses / investigation steps / evidence / project context per P-031; hybrid render — Resolved incidents с parseable resolution_summary_text JSON yield full six-section output, Active / Acknowledged OR Resolved incidents с unparseable summary yield degraded-mode rendering omitting hypotheses + investigation_steps с explicit notice; markdown serialization byte-identical к future MCP delivery #92 per P-038; PII scrubbed at the resolver boundary per chunk #72 uniform-coverage discipline; anonymized telemetry excerpts per P-035; aggregate-only observability fields per CLAUDE.md observability 2026-05-17 session 84; capabilities P-031 Report Structure + P-035 Anonymized Telemetry Excerpts + P-036 Cross-Incident Pattern Reference (Previously Seen field reserved; current resolver returns empty Vec; corpus fingerprint-similarity query path is а follow-up chunk) + P-037 In-App Report Surface + P-038 Copy to Clipboard). Per chunk #95 also covers storage.export_for_training (anonymized JSONL corpus export for community training per capability P-046 — reads ALL incidents, scrubs every user-facing text field at the egress boundary via security::scrubber::scrub_attribute, preview-before-write gate via the confirm flag, no auto-submission; writes a local file to a user-chosen path defaulting to ~/Downloads/pulse-corpus-export-{timestamp}.jsonl — a deliberate out-of-data-dir export sink outside the §Critical Warnings data-dir-confinement boundary, validated for `..` traversal + parent-dir existence before write). Per chunk #96 also covers config.{reload,status} (configuration hot-reload — config.reload is the manual re-read trigger, config.status returns the last-reload timestamp + error category + restart-required pending count; the notify watcher hot-applies cadence + lifecycle keys within ~2s and raises a restart-required notice for Drain/retention/MCP keys via pulse://stream/config-events) + diagnostics.reevaluate_recent_window (opt-in retrospective re-evaluation re-classifying every tracked service against the freshly hot-reloaded lifecycle thresholds; prospective-by-default per capabilities P-055 / P-056). Per chunk #97 also covers diagnostics.{snapshot,history} (Settings → Diagnostics view — read-only L6 self-observability surface per capability P-058; snapshot aggregates the live point-in-time pipeline state that already exists — model tier/profile/load-status + backoff countdown + Drain template count + hardware profile — and marks not-yet-produced sub-fields (inference success rate, queue depth, per-layer L0-L5 numerics) as not-yet-recorded rather than fabricating them; history validates metric_name against a bounded allowlist + bounds the window but is a stub returning an empty series + notice until a numeric-metric-history producer chunk lands; aggregate-only observability per CLAUDE.md observability 2026-05-17 session 84). Per 2026-06-28 (P-072) also covers investigate.run_action (Investigate-action L4-backed analysis — runs a real LlmInferenceRunner::generate_constrained analysis of the curated telemetry for one of the 4 actions and returns a transient structured result; NO incident is created or persisted; reuses the incident L4Output schema; honours the deterministic env-gated L4 mode P-073 for reproducibility; PII scrubbed at the resolver egress boundary; aggregate-only observability). Per 2026-06-29 (P-061 · intent F1) also grants core:window:allow-start-dragging (the frameless custom-titlebar data-tauri-drag-region needs it to move the window — silently rejected under core:default, whose core:window:default is getters + internal-toggle-maximize only) plus allow-minimize + allow-toggle-maximize for the titlebar minimize/maximize controls (same missing-permission root cause). Per 2026-06-29 (P-063 residual, surfaced during P-062 verification) also grants core:window:allow-close — the frameless custom-titlebar close button calls getCurrentWindow().close(), silently rejected without the grant so the Rust CloseRequested→hide-to-tray interception never fired (the ✕ did nothing); allow-close lets close() reach the handler which prevent_close()+hide()es to the tray. Per 2026-06-30 (P-066 · intent F6) also grants core:window:allow-show + allow-set-focus + allow-hide — the new in-widget "Toggle dashboard" titlebar button on the compact-widget opens+focuses the main dashboard window when hidden and hides it when visible (the glance widget always stays put) via @tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow; these also unblock the previously-silent use-keyboard-shortcuts Cmd+Shift+P path (same missing-permission root cause as P-061/P-063, since core:default is getters-only). These are core window permissions, not new TauRPC procedures (no capability-drift impact) and not one of the 3 NEVER-widen caps (no capability-widening-check impact).
